name: solo-review
title_zh: 只审自己刚改的那几行，不碰别的文件
tagline_zh: 改完代码想找人挑刺？它开一个只读会话，用全新上下文看你的 diff，把问题发回总线。不拉群、不建 worker。
tagline_en: Finished a diff and want a fresh set of eyes? It opens a read-only session, reads your change with zero context.
desc_en: Isolated review of your own diff. A read-only Promptobus reviewer session reads the change with a fresh context and sends findings on the bus. Use when asked to raise a reviewer, check a diff, or review a branch with new eyes. Not for spawning workers or running a multi-repo task (that is orchestrate).
why_zh: 隔离审查：新会话不带旧记忆，避免你被自己的惯性思维带偏。只读不写，看完就散，不污染主线。
why_en: Isolated review: a fresh context with no memory of your earlier reasoning, so it catches what you've stopped seeing. Read-only.
limit_zh: 只审单个 diff，不接多仓库或派 worker 的编排任务。需要对比分支历史、跑测试或改代码时它不干活。
limit_en: Single-diff only; no multi-repo orchestration or worker spawning. Won't compare branch history, run tests, or edit code—just sends findings back for.
title_en: Review only your own diff, nothing else
